name: ai-developer-tracker
description: Track developer coding activity, AI interactions, and code changes during AI-assisted coding sessions.

ai-developer-tracker.assessment.apiOrigi.description: Trusted Rails HTTPS origin implementing R4.2D, for example https://assessment.example.com. Empty disables pairing. Only user settings are read. No credentials, paths, queries or fragments. Reload after changes; separate recording and upload consent remain required.

ai-developer-tracker.assessment.mock.ena.description: Development only: enable an explicit local assessment mock after reload. No Rails calls or assessment event uploads. Never use for real interviews. Only user settings are read; the mock server does not survive reload.

ai-developer-tracker.upload.endpoint.description: HTTPS event endpoint. Empty disables uploads. Only user settings are used; changes revoke upload consent. Credentials, query strings and fragments are prohibited.

ai-developer-tracker.upload.enabled.description: Upload status mirror. Settings cannot authorize uploads. Use Enable Uploads for separate explicit consent; reload always disables uploads. Set false to revoke consent.

ai-developer-tracker.upload.maxEvents.description: Maximum events per upload batch. Changes disable uploads and require fresh consent.

ai-developer-tracker.upload.maxBytes.description: Maximum serialized upload request bytes. Changes disable uploads and require fresh consent.

ai-developer-tracker.upload.timeoutMs.description: Upload operation timeout in milliseconds. Changes disable uploads and require fresh consent.

ai-developer-tracker.retention.days.description: Days to retain closed, fully acknowledged recording sessions and metadata-only diagnostics. Pending evidence and historical plaintext logs are never automatically deleted. Set 0 to disable expiration. Only user settings are used.

ai-developer-tracker.queue.maxSizeMB.description: Maximum SQLite queue storage in MB (1 MB = 1048576 bytes), including journal sidecars. Warns at 80%; stops collection when an event cannot safely fit. Existing events are never automatically deleted. Reload the extension to apply changes.

ai-developer-tracker.codex.enabled.description: Discover local Codex session metadata during recording. Association always requires confirmation. Reload the extension to apply changes.

ai-developer-tracker.codex.sessionsDirec.description: Absolute local Codex sessions directory for testing or custom installations. Empty uses ~/.codex/sessions. Workspace settings cannot redirect discovery. Reload the extension to apply changes.

ai-developer-tracker.diff.maxFileBytes.description: Maximum UTF-8 file size to capture. Larger files produce reconstruction gaps. Reload the extension to apply changes.

ai-developer-tracker.diff.maxDiffBytes.description: Maximum unified patch size in bytes. Reload the extension to apply changes.

ai-developer-tracker.diff.maxMemoryBytes.description: Maximum retained baseline content in memory. Reload the extension to apply changes.

ai-developer-tracker.diff.debounceMs.description: Idle delay before an editor diff checkpoint. Reload the extension to apply changes.

ai-developer-tracker.diff.maxCheckpointM.description: Maximum grouping interval during continuous typing. Reload the extension to apply changes.

ai-developer-tracker.diff.diffTimeoutMs.description: Computation time budget per asynchronous diff. Reload the extension to apply changes.
